name: Channels the Spirit World
description: You possess the ability to communicate with the dead and channel spirits, but this gift comes with a terrible price.
connectionOptions: One PC lost a loved one and seeks your help to communicate with them.
You've sensed a malevolent spirit attached to one PC.
One PC witnessed one of your séances go horribly wrong.
You believe one PC has latent medium abilities and want to mentor them.
additionalEquipment: Vial of laudanum for calming nerves

abilities.name: Spirit Sight
abilities.description: You can see and communicate with spirits invisible to others. You're trained in tasks involving ghostly perception and interaction.

abilities.name: Séance Mastery
abilities.description: You're trained in conducting séances and can attempt to contact specific spirits.

abilities.name: Spectral Shield
abilities.description: You can create a barrier against malevolent spirits. You and nearby allies gain +2 Armor against attacks from incorporeal entities.

abilities.name: Channel the Dead
abilities.description: You can allow a spirit to temporarily possess you to gain information or skills. This is risky and may have unforeseen consequences.

abilities.name: Exorcism
abilities.description: You can attempt to banish a possessing spirit or exorcise a haunted location. This is a difficult Intellect task.

abilities.name: Ghostly Manifestation
abilities.description: You can temporarily manifest a spirit in a visible, audible form. This spirit can interact with the physical world in limited ways.

abilities.name: Bridge Between Worlds
abilities.description: Once per session, you can open a temporary portal to the spirit world. This is extremely dangerous and unpredictable.
